pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo bhikkhuniyā ummaddāpenti pi parimaddāpenti pi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo bhikkhuniyā ummaddāpessanti pi parimaddāpessanti pi, seyyathāpi gihikāmabhoginiyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo . . . parimaddāpessanti pīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo . . . parimaddāpenti pīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.11: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo . . . parimaddāpessanti pi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.14.1: yā pana bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā ummaddāpeyya vā parimaddāpeyya vā, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
